summary: Forward child session detail reads to the owning host and correct child routing regression fixtures

replay.detail: No stored claims or transcript content changes.

rules.detail: Claim rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds an internal peer session-detail read operation. All gateways and owners must run this build for remote child details, as with the new three-field child encoding; mixed versions are unsupported.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond normal upgrade restarts.

manual.detail: Upgrade gateways and owners together and reopen parent conversations to regenerate child links.

recovery.detail: No data migration. Roll back gateways and owners together and regenerate volatile child links.
